scope: US direct self-serve Typeform Basic subscription, active prepaid monthly or annual term, organization owner or admin, cancellation at actual term end only.
excluded: Plus, Business, Growth, Enterprise and custom or legacy agreements
immediate deletion, immediate termination, refund entitlement or proof of execution

sources.finding: Cancellation requires the completed survey and final confirmation. Access changes at paid-term end; starting the flow does not prove success.
Monthly and annual cancellation takes effect at the actual prepaid expiry. Paid-feature forms may close; stored responses remain. Refunds are a separate policy question.
Organization settings are accessible to organization owners and admins; Plan and Billing contains subscription controls. An asserted role is not authentication.

release_prerequisites: Review and admit the exact vendor-policy scope without implying coverage of the other policy families.
Represent product, plan and purchase channel in the public request and cross-repository binding contracts.
Use reviewed, monitored source evidence through the service-only runtime boundary. This research file is not runtime evidence.
Bind fresh account facts and authenticated authority to the same organization using a trusted adapter.
Keep user consent, execution and provider confirmation in the application layer.
Verify exact-source CI and approve a separate production release.
